repos.name: VIctory
repos.description: An attempt at running GTA VI on PC

repos.name: rust-anything
repos.description: Rewrite your app in Rust, piece by piece, checked against the original at every step. Works with TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, Ruby, Java, C, PHP, C#, Kotlin and PowerShell.

repos.name: xcl
repos.description: Xbox Series compatibility layer for Windows - runs console game code natively, reimplements the console system libraries and recompiles RDNA2 shaders to DXIL

repos.name: portwatch-vi
repos.description: Does GTA VI run on PC yet? A live tracker of community recompilation and emulation efforts, updated daily.

repos.name: ung220z-tool
repos.description: ung220z-tool 是一个针对 UNG220Z，另含中兴/烽火/华为/九联多厂商适配、固件指纹识别与分家族排障建议的一键凭据提取工具，仅限在你自己的设备上用于找回忘记的管理密码、迁移宽带配置或安全自查。

repos.name: fast-anything
repos.description: Don't rewrite it in Rust. Rewrite the 5% that's slow: profile your app, port the hot functions with your coding agent, prove they behave the same. Python, JS/TS, Ruby, Java, Kotlin, Go, PHP, C/C++, C#, R.

repos.name: VIctory-NVIDIA
repos.description: VIctory (Xbox Series compatibility layer) tuned for NVIDIA RTX cards: Series X at 2560x1440 with DLSS, about 26-30 fps on an RTX 5070, DLSS frame generation 2x-6x, an F1 settings menu and F3 stats panel, open water without dark blocks. Built on many repos combined into one. No game files or NVIDIA files included.

repos.name: xnulinux
repos.description: XNU as a loadable kernel module inside Linux (macOS personality for arm64 Linux)

repos.name: victory-fork
repos.description: Work-in-progress fork of VIctory: getting an Xbox Series title to render and run on a Windows PC. No game files.

repos.name: obsidian-prism
repos.description: Optical UI, damped-spring choreography, 512K shallow-water vial, pixel mascots & dual-mode thought suite for Antigravity (GPL-3.0)
